historic_status.reason: No evaluation and 45 years or older

hook: A rental cottage of 1937 by Leo R. Miller, rebuilt after a fire in 1965.

building.completed_conflict: The survey dates the house to June 1937 and the assessor's roll to 1938.

historic_survey.finding: Appears ineligible for the National Register and the California Register under every criterion — built as rental housing, unconnected to the boat-building community, and of low integrity
historic_survey.note: The form's locational-data field gives Lot 003B, the lot next door; its own identifier field gives Lot 003A. The survey names no architect.

historical_record.description: Fire partially destroyed the dwelling. Its builder applied in September of that year for a permit to rebuild it, and the house that stands is that rebuilding.
